title: Kendall Nashville - Belle Meade Gem • BBQ + Mini P
description:
The Kendall Nashville. Experience mid-century modern charm in this spacious 4-bedroom house, just a quick 10-minute drive from downtown Nashville. Enjoy a granite kitchen, abundant natural light, and a large covered deck with great views. Perfect for families and groups, this home offers a comfortable retreat with modern amenities, including a BBQ grill and a fully equipped kitchen. Explore nearby attractions like the Grand Ole Opry.

The space
🏡 Charming Mid-Century Home in Prime Nashville Location
➝Located next to Belle Meade, where Nashville’s rich & famous live
➝Nestled in a quiet, historic neighborhood of post-WWII cottages
➝Experience true local charm with modern comfort

🎉 Perfect for Groups & Bachelorette Weekends
➝Ideal for bachelorettes, families, or friend getaways
➝Feel like a local while being close to all the action

📍 Unbeatable Central Location
➝Just 5 miles to Downtown Nashville
➝Only 3 miles to Vanderbilt & Belmont University
➝Quick access to Music City Center, Broadway, and more

🛏️ Comfortable Space for Up to 12 Guests
➝4 Bedrooms + Bonus: 1 King Bed, 3 Queen Beds, 3 Twin Beds
➝Additional Sleep Options:  Full Futon, plus a full-length couch
➝Sleeps up to 12 guests comfortably

🎶 Near Top Nashville Attractions
➝Minutes from Belle Meade Plantation & Cheekwood Gardens
➝Close to the Grand Ole Opry, Bluebird Cafe, Ryman Auditorium
➝Surrounded by some of the coolest restaurants in the country

Guest access
There is a large deck and covered patio with tables and a couch for seating.

Other things to note
There is a camera on the front door.
